project_info.application_name: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Management System
project_info.network_architecture: Multi-tier cloud architecture with public-facing web application served via CloudFront/S3, API Gateway for REST APIs, Network Load Balancer for EVSE connections, Application Load Balancer for internal microservices communication, serverless Lambda functions for message routing, and multiple data storage layers (DynamoDB, S3, QLDB)
key_components: EVSE Connection Layer (ECS on Fargate + NLB)
Internal API Layer (Application Load Balancer + ECS)
